headline: Coca-Cola HBC Completes $2.6B Acquisition of Coca-Cola Beverages Africa
summary: Coca-Cola HBC has completed its $2.6 billion acquisition of a 75% stake in Coca-Cola Beverages Africa, expanding its operations to 43 markets and becoming the world's second-largest bottler by volume.
why: Large cross-border M&A transactions alter regional bottling capacity, distribution footprints, and consolidated financial reporting for multinational beverage groups.

impacts.name: Coca-Cola HBC
impacts.why: Acquiring a controlling stake expands geographic scale and revenue contribution.
